community.label: Plugin comments and likes
community.identity: No sign-in is needed. This installation uses an anonymous identity separate from your browser. Clearing app data removes your ability to delete earlier comments or undo earlier likes.
install.notice: Plugins can read and modify your notes. The plugin center reviews functionality and sources, but cannot guarantee freedom from defects. Install only plugins you trust. Installation enables a plugin; disable it from Installed at any time. Editor and whiteboard content plugins take effect after restart; other plugins take effect immediately.
install.backendNotice: This plugin includes a local backend with the current user's system permissions. Running in a separate process does not restrict file or network access. The plugin center has reviewed this version's system capabilities, but cannot guarantee freedom from defects.
install.skip: Skip future notices (plugins with backends still show a notice; restore this preference from ⋯ on the plugins page)
install.changesHint: Changes involving content plugins take effect after restart.
install.uninstallHint: This disables the plugin and removes its code and previous-version backups. Its entry points are removed. Content already written to notes is preserved.
install.purge: Also delete plugin settings, records, content and local credentials for this workspace
install.keepData: Plugin data is kept for reinstallation by default, and can be cleared per plugin later under Uninstalled plugin data without reinstalling. If you choose to delete it, workspace deletions sync to other devices.
backend.notice: This plugin's local backend can use the current user's system permissions. A separate process does not restrict file or network access. Allow only plugins you trust.
backend.reviewed: The plugin center reviewed this version's system capabilities
backend.unreviewed: Installed locally; system capabilities were not reviewed by the plugin center
backend.persistent: Keep running for the scope's lifetime
backend.disabled: This plugin is disabled. Enable it after granting permission to run it.
backend.always: Allow this version to run automatically
error.cleanupUnconfirmed: Plugin cleanup could not be confirmed. Restart the app before enabling it again. Saved data is preserved.
